messages:

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>

Subject: Proposed on-prem upgrade window + pinning & rollback checklist

Hi Priya / team —

As discussed on the call this morning, we want to lock in the maintenance window for the Redwood Private (VPC) agent and control plane updates on your staging and prod air-gapped clusters. Proposed details: 

- Target upgrade window (prod): Sat 2026-03-07 02:00-05:00 PT (3 hours)
- Staging validation: Fri 2026-03-06 22:00-23:30 PT
- Version pinning approach: control-plane to v1.18.3, runtime agent pinned to 5.2.1 with a canary set of 3 nodes (see checklist)
- Rollback plan: automated config rollback to previous image tag + wizarded KV cache invalidation; manual operator rollback steps in runbook

I've attached a first-pass checklist (redwood_onprem_patch_checklist_v1.pdf) and the network ACL matrix we need updated in advance (network_acl_matrix.xlsx). Can you confirm the window or propose alternatives? Also flag any procurement/change freeze windows from your side (CorpSec mentioned quarterly freeze windows last quarter).

Next steps I propose:
1) Priya: confirm approval and any blackout dates
2) Karthik / Hannah: confirm canary hosts and smoke test list
3) Lauren: prepare comms and Drills playbook for CS/Support

Thanks — short replies welcome.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Product Operations | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Proposed on-prem upgrade window + pinning & rollback checklist

Folks —

Couple of technical notes / clarifications from the engineering side: 

1) Version pinning details:
   - Control plane: pin to v1.18.3 with immutability on the release tag (we'll only move tag after post-rollout eval).
   - Runtime agent: pin to 5.2.1. Agents expose a graceful rollback that reverts the agent binary and resets the KV cache. Tagging scheme: redwood/agent:5.2.1 and redwood/agent:5.2.0-rc for quick fallback.

2) Canary & sequencing:
   - Canary set: 3 hosts in prod (isolated AZ) 
   - Sequencing: staging -> canary -> full fleet. Wait windows: 30m after control plane, 20m after runtime agent, automated health checks (latency SLOs + error rate thresholds).

3) Network changes:
   - We'll require a short ACL adjustment: open egress 443 to our artifact repo (internal-only) and a 1-minute ephemeral exception for image pull. The ACL matrix must include the CIDR we publish.

4) Rollback runbook (high-level):
   - Step A: Quiesce ingress traffic via traffic-manager -> route 10% -> 0%
   - Step B: Terraform apply rollback-plan (revert control-plane image tags)
   - Step C: Agent binary rollback + KV cache reset script (scripts/rollback_agent.sh)
   - Step D: Validate with smoke tests (login, infer test 100 reqs/min for 5m)

I've uploaded the detailed runbook to the SharePoint link and created JIRA ONPREM-4521 for the change ticket. I recommend we separate the control plane and agent window by 30m to avoid cascading failures during image pull.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Lead, Inference Infrastructure — Redwood Inference
